snippet.title: AD BLOCKER: An Action Puzzle Game Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Lights...Camera...It's the release trailer for AD BLOCKER: An Action Puzzle Game, releasing to Steam on 2/28/2025!

A fast-paced head-to-head puzzler featuring grid-based gravity and a unique linear garbage system. Challenge an eccentric cast of characters in Story Mode, or host a Quick Match for 0-2 players! Are you ready to block some ads? Wishlist AD BLOCKER here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187360/AD_BLOCKER_An_Action_Puzzle_Game/
